$comment: The allowlist permission profile (ADR 0016, spec #94). launch.ps1 writes it into an IC's per-session settings when the manifest pins permissions: allowlist, which assignment.js allows only for haiku. The session runs permission mode acceptEdits: Edit and Write inside the assignment worktree need no rule, everything else the IC role touches is pre-approved below. Tokens: <fleet> is the fleet root the launch runs from (forward slashes); <defaultBranch> and <releaseBranch> come from the tenant file. A permission wait in a rehearsal is a missing line here: add the rule with the ic.md step that needs it. The tool-contract deny rules launch.ps1 injects for every IC are still written and deny beats allow; the deny list below stands in for the autoMode soft_deny lines, which acceptEdits never consults.
